<b>Corrcrust Karakas</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are members of the [[Order of Karak]] with head and shoulders covered in crust-growth, which they use to shoot out orange bubbles. Now extinct in modern [[Pharloom]], they live on only in memory.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Being flying enemies, Corrcrust Karakas try to maintain a position diagonally above Hornet between attacks. Once they can, they use any of the following attacks:
* <b>Bubble Spray:</b> Ejects harmful orange bubbles in all directions. The bubbles begin to rapidly pop around 1 second after the last bubble has been ejected. 
* <b>Ground Slam:</b> Quickly flies above Hornet and slams down vertically, leaving a thin trail of bubbles during their descent and ejecting a few to the sides as they land. The bubbles all rapidly pop around 1 second after the last bubble is spawned by the attack.
* <b>Flying Slam:</b> Flies down if necessary to be more horizontally aligned with Hornet and charges towards her until it hits a wall, leaving a trail of bubbles as they charge and ejecting more on the impact with said wall. The bubbles rapidly pop in sequence around 1 second after the Corrcrust Karaka hits the wall.

It should be noted that the bubbles' hitboxes do not increase in size when they pop, and that the bubbles immediately pop upon being hit by any attack or [[Tool]].<br>
Due to the sheer amount of area denial Corrcrust Karakas are capable of, Hornet should make sure not to corner herself and always have an escape option.

== Location ==
Corrcrust Karakas can only be found in [[Crust King Khann]]'s [[Elegy of the Deep|Memory]] of the [[Coral Tower]] during [[Acts|Act 3]].
